verdict.rationale: The DOS certificate-of-incorporation page says that "Online filing is available on the Department of State's website." It also says filers get an emailed acknowledgement with a PDF filing receipt after filing online, and it links the Online Filing System alongside the paper mail rail. That meets the story's test that the core formation transaction can be completed online per the service's own pages. The filing-host probe failure only shows that keyless agents are blocked; it does not contradict founder online filing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that payment is taken online within the filing flow (the card-payment instruction describes a mailed authorization form), a clear online fee (the published "$9" sits awkwardly beside the $125 statutory fee), hands-on or independent confirmation of the online filing app (the host could not be fetched).
